# Rearview

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** Rearview

## What it does

An overlay on your screen that will show a picture-in-picture view of what's behind you

Description basis: [publisher description](https://www.vape.gg/index.php/features). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
